layouts._note: the Rust builder (Longshot #2286, nightly-895+): a profile folder per player, mods directly inside it. Verified on a real install: %LOCALAPPDATA%/Longshot/data/profiles/default/{profile.json,mods}.
standalone builds of the same line keep an older profile/ folder beside the game folder.
RecompLauncher's per-user place (older builder line): settings and mods.json beside the game's user folder.

versions.built_for: Modding API 0.1 as documented on mod-api and implemented in PR #2434 (feat/game-rs, WIP; rebased on the Rust builder as of 2026-11-28)
versions.fallback: one artifact family (a Longshot mod folder) serves every Longshot release whose Modding API is 0.1: the mod probes has('capture.frame')/has('game.pause')/hideGameHud and degrades per subsystem; the feature floor is photo mode (free camera) with capture logged as a plan until the capture seam lands (see seams.md). NOTE: no public release carries API 0.1 yet (verified 2026-11-28): stable v3.2.0's binary has no Modding API; nightly-895's Rust builder lists 'mod' as a builder capability but every 'Longshot.exe mod <cmd>' answers 'mod tooling not built in to this builder' (exit 125), and its info reports a game with no mod-API capability. This mod loads only where API 0.1 ships. A mod written for API 0.2 would need its own api pin.
